statement: The raw bits of the returned maximum equal those of the highest-ranked input.

adapter.mapping: Code plus one uses bijective base four, least significant digit first, to construct a nonempty double[] of length 1 to 3. Digits select -1.0, -0.0, +0.0 and +1.0 in that order. Numeric equality treats the two zeroes as equal. Raw bits use a 16-digit hexadecimal word.
